moods.mood_description: Finish the final edict and secure the succession of dharma
The legacy of an empire and the soul of an old man
Half-blind, surrounded, still dictating from memory
Poison and forged documents; will gentleness survive?
The old logic says execute the traitor; the new says forgive
He does not kill her; he writes an edict on clemency
The final chisel stroke is also a final vow
The stone will outlast the dynasty
The man who once measured men by the thousand now calls them all his children
